notes.title: Global Update 1.2
notes.notes:
[b]Happy New Year![/b]

In this update we took into account all the wishes of the players and changed the game accordingly, and at the same time fixing some bugs:

1. There is a button to start a new game in the pause menu. Now you do not have to first kill your character to start a new game.
2. Prescribed all the random events (in two languages: Russian and English) after the post Manager, which may happen to you at work.
You will no longer see the standard notification "Positive Event 1".
3. changed the icons of other items in the store to a more beautiful and better quality.
4) Fixed some bugs, when buys are doubled in the store. There should be no strange charges.
5. The game decided to crash only one user, but we still slightly optimized it as a whole. 
6. Many players complained that the time in the game went too slow, making the gameplay boring.
That's why it was decided to speed up the game time. The pause button didn't go anywhere, so you can always pause the game and build further strategy.
7. Added a tooltip when hovering over the save game button, which says that the game is periodically saved automatically. This is for your peace of mind.
8. Updated the start date of the new game, keep up to date ;)
9. Redesigned game balance.
10. Added a tooltip when hovering over the hourglass. There you can also see if the pause now or not.
11. Removed button to open the business. This functionality has gone on a complete redesign, and will appear in the next update.
12. In the description of the car and real estate in the purchase is now brought out the tax that you have to pay every day for the maintenance of the car, or house after its purchase.

[i][b]At this point all known issues have been fixed, thank you for your feedback! We will continue to improve the project and fill it with content to keep your time interesting.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Announcing COSMO
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi![/h1]
We would like to share with you the good news, we are announcing a new space project - [b]COSMO[/b], which we first started doing about seven years ago, and only now it has reached Steam. ːsteamhappyː This is a cooperative sandbox, where the player has to become a spacecraft pilot and choose his way in the open, ever-growing world of the game. There waiting for you PvE battles with friends, research, resource extraction, industry and construction.

To learn more about the game, click on the picture below.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461900/][img]https://sun9-62.userapi.com/pGsNLEctNTGemVM2GAQRkVYHrjd4OBLbQ3LUGA/H5N6S7lq5Fo.jpg[/img][/url]


Here you are free to decide what you want to do. Explore space, make new discoveries, extract resources, build new ships, equip them with modules, engage in industry, pump character skills, and much more. You can do all this at once alone, or you can invite a friend to the game and share the responsibilities. Together is always more fun and faster things go.

[h2]Key features of the game:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Borderless space
[*] Cooperative mode
[*] Total freedom of action
[*] A lot of different activities
[*] More than 15 enemy ships with unique features, tactics and different characteristics
[*] Over 20 types of resources needed for construction or trade
[*] About 30 different ships (from a mining or cargo ship to a real war monster).
[*] Over 50 character skills, opening up new opportunities
[*] Over 100 modules of different types to equip the spacecraft
[/list]

Add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461900/]Cosmo[/url] to your wish list so you don't miss its release and know all the latest news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461900/

You can also subscribe to our YouTube channel to learn more about the game.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LedqIf-qWa0
See you in space, pilot!

notes.title: Save the Planet release!
notes.notes:
We want to share with you the happy news that our second project "Save the Planet"has just been released!
You can view the game by clicking on the image.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1420730/Save_the_Planet/][img]https://sun9-46.userapi.com/cyZ43hYekZaTVnhcMzscW2Z5r0X9Jcrf-hkmCA/AznMolNQwfY.jpg[/img][/url]


The player will have to defend their planet from alien attacks by repelling their projectiles by controlling the orbital platform. Passing more and more powerful waves of enemies, your platform will be available to various types of firearms improvements that can hit the aliens.

Score points, upgrade your weapon, pass waves and compete with your friends in the online highscore table, become the best! And for hardcore fans, the "crazy mode" is available, where it is extremely difficult to control the orbital platform, but very fun and funny. I wonder if you can reach at least the 10th wave in this mode?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1420730/Save_the_Planet/]Save the Planet[/url]

notes.title: Future plan
notes.notes:
We wrote in the previous news that we will support the "Business Simulator" with at least two small updates. However, now the situation has changed a little, all our forces are thrown at the release of the game "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1420730/]Save the Planet[/url]", which will be released in a week. After that, we will fully return to the "Business" and release 1 global patch that fixes all known bugs, brings a lot of new content and features to the game, and you will see a completely redesigned balance.

We can't say anything about the exact release date of this patch yet, but we can firmly say that the update will be in November 2020. In addition to it a small surprise ːsteamhappyː

Follow the news and subscribe to our social networks to stay up to date.
